meta.name: list-building
meta.description: Expert B2B list building orchestrator for outbound sales campaigns. Use when the user asks about building lead lists, Sales Navigator search, boolean filters, ICP definition, ICP scoring, lead sources, data validation, email verification, list segmentation, Apollo prospecting, Clay Find People, list hygiene, deduplication, account qualification, ABM lists, or assembling prospect lists for cold outreach. Also triggers on "lead list", "list building", "Sales Navigator", "boolean search", "ICP", "ideal customer profile", "find leads", "prospect list", "lead source", "email verification", "data validation", "list hygiene", "Evaboot", "PhantomBuster", "export leads", "build a list", "find prospects", "deduplicate", "qualify accounts", "ABM". Do NOT use for enrichment workflows (use clay skill) or email writing (use cold-email skill).

copy.tagline: 快速构建精准B2B销售线索列表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统化搭建B2B外呼线索列表
copy.tagline_en: Build targeted B2B prospect lists fast
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically build outbound sales lists

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会根据你的需求引导完成 B2B 潜在客户列表构建：先定义理想客户画像，再寻找公司、联系人，然后验证邮箱、去重等。如果可用，它会优先推荐 ColdIQ 工具链来一体化完成。
howto.when: 当你提到“潜在客户列表”“销售导航搜索”“布尔搜索”等关键词，或要求构建外呼名单时触发。

say.text: 帮我构建一个面向 SaaS 公司的潜在客户列表。
say.note: 会引导你定义 ICP 并选择数据源。

say.text: 如何在 Sales Navigator 中用布尔搜索找到决策者？
say.note: 会调用查找联系人子技能。

say.text: 验证这个邮件列表并去除重复。
say.note: 会调用清洗验证和去重子技能。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through building a B2B prospect list: define ICP, find companies, find contacts, verify emails, and deduplicate. It prioritizes ColdIQ toolchain when available.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "prospect list", "Sales Navigator search", "boolean search", or request to build an outbound list.

say_en.text: Build a prospect list for SaaS companies.
say_en.note: Guides you to define ICP and choose data sources.
